raws.title: Early Childhood Education Teacher
raws.summary: Plan, implement and assess preschool pedagogy with a team and help lead the team. The role also involves close cooperation with children’s families.

requirements.text: Qualification required under the Early Childhood Education Act
Bachelor’s degree including early childhood teacher training, or equivalent
Criminal record extract for working with children
Ability to meet children and parents individually, respectfully and sensitively
requirements.question: What does 'meeting children and parents sensitively' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting values an individual, respectful and sensitive approach to children and parents.
